items.event_time_ist: Oct 19, 2026 (Silver Bulletin model refresh released Monday; reported Oct 20–21)
items.title: Silver Bulletin sharply upgrades Democrats: 94% House, 75% Senate (up from 81%/50% in early Sept)
items.summary: Nate Silver's Silver Bulletin issued a sharply upgraded 2026 midterm forecast on Monday, Oct 19: Democrats at 94% to win the House (up from 81% in early September) and 75% to win the Senate (up from 50%). Silver argues fellow forecasters are 'boring and risk-averse' for hedging the Senate, saying Dems are better positioned than toss-up treatment suggests: Mary Peltola (AK), James Talarico (TX) and Sherrod Brown (OH) have 'led in the vast majority of polls,' and those three pickups plus North Carolina suffice for a 51-49 Dem map. Silver notes both chambers flipping in one cycle has happened only twice in 70 years (1994, 2006); for comparison, DDHQ puts Dem Senate control at 56% and prediction markets at ~65%.
